source.derivation: This timing run benchmarks the frozen distribution DSO; it does not rebuild. source.head is the commit whose build-relevant tree produced that DSO, not the current checkout HEAD.
source.head: fc2716652735fb829298d7f426141bd8f9936fc8

protocol.exclusions: none may be introduced after execution
protocol.exhaustion_policy: a failed or resource-exhausted run is BLOCKED, never PASS
protocol.frozen_subject: the distribution DSO at 553e1b8c built by the PFP-20/21 campaign from c1d25e10d; no rebuild
protocol.multiplicity: Holm-Bonferroni across the declared workload family (alpha=0.05)
protocol.statistic: median of paired per-repetition ratios candidate_us/authority_us
protocol.stopping_rule: fixed repetition count; no early stop and no replacement
protocol.unit_of_replication: one process per subject per repetition
protocol.warmup: one unrecorded pair before repetition 00; excluded from statistics

multiplicity.method: Holm-Bonferroni over two-sided sign-test p-values; Bonferroni family-wise interval for each ratio
